name: Bitly Shortener
description: Shortens URLs through the Bitly API via a service, a Twig function, and a block.
project_description: Bitly Shortener integrates a Drupal site with the Bitly URL-shortening service. It exposes a service (bitly_shortener) with a single shortener($url) method that POSTs a long URL to the Bitly v4 bitlinks API and returns the short link, a Twig function bitly_shortener() that wraps the service so links can be shortened at template render time, and a block (Bitly Shortener) that shortens the current page URL and renders it with a copy-to-clipboard button. Configuration lives at /admin/config/bitly-shortener/api behind the 'administer site configuration' permission, where an admin stores the Bitly access token, the API endpoint, and an enable flag. The module requires no modules outside Drupal core.
